Definition: a form of G3017; Lewis (i.e. Levi), a Christian:--Levi.
BiblicalUsage: Leuḯs means Levi. In Luke 5:29, "And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Levi's great feast is the picture of a changed life — the tax collector who followed Jesus threw open his house the same day.
